l4_icans_grade_steroids.quote: Third, treat ICANS immediately with dexamethasone 10 mg IV every 6 hours; if there is no improvement within 24 hours

l4_crs_management.quote: an isotonic crystalloid bolus of 500-1000 mL for BP 96/58, then norepinephrine to maintain MAP at least 65 mmHg if fluid-refractory

l4_neutropenic_sepsis.quote: obtain blood cultures and start broad-spectrum antibiotics within 1 hour (piperacillin-tazobactam or cefepime, adding vancomycin for central-line/MRSA risk)

l4_airway_icu_seizure.quote: increase levetiracetam to 750-1000 mg twice daily (renally adjusted), obtain an urgent EEG, and treat clinical seizures with benzodiazepines

l4_ddx_cns_relapse.quote: I would also keep CNS lymphoma progression in mind given his high CNS-IPI, though the acute day +6 timing strongly favors ICANS

l4_ddx_infection_bleed.quote: CNS infection is a major concern, including HSV encephalitis, VZV, CMV, EBV, HHV-6 (a classic post-CAR-T limbic encephalitis

l4_ddx_metabolic_seizure.quote: nonconvulsive status epilepticus, intracerebral hemorrhage, ischemic stroke, cerebral venous sinus thrombosis

l4_ct_then_mri.quote: obtain an emergent noncontrast CT head to exclude hemorrhage and edema, followed by MRI brain with contrast and MRV

l4_eeg_lp_safe.quote: Lumbar puncture only after imaging and neurosurgical clearance, and after platelets are at least 50,000-100,000/uL and INR is corrected: send cell count, protein, glucose, cytology, flow cytometry, bacterial, fungal and AFB cultures

l4_mn_lp_unsafe.quote: defer lumbar puncture until imaging is reviewed and platelets/coagulation are corrected.

l4_mn_withhold_steroids_for_tcell.quote: Do not delay antibiotics or steroids for imaging or lumbar puncture.
